conclusion: Theni District’s official Survey and Land Records office and Tamil Nadu land-record procedures were evidenced, including FMB/Chitta/TSLR and A-Register services. Direct anonymous access to the official e-Services host timed out, and no parcel ID-plus-geometry response or public service schema was obtained. The packet is complete as research evidence but runtime readiness remains held.
